description: Covers research data management around software: organizing and documenting datasets (layout, data dictionaries), keeping data out of git while versioning it properly (DVC, git-annex, DataLad), FAIR data and metadata standards, depositing data with DOIs in repositories such as Zenodo, licensing data, and handling sensitive or personal data. Use PROACTIVELY when a project reads or produces datasets, when the user asks where to put data, how to version or share large files, how to document a dataset, which data license or repository to use, or when data files are about to be committed to a code repository. (Format engineering - HDF5, NetCDF, Parquet, chunking - is rseng-scientific-file-formats; funder data management plans are rseng-data-management-plans.)
